admin.title: Admin
admin.description: Providers, GPU policy, budgets and telemetry for this AcuDx deployment. Every change is saved on the server; no key ever reaches the browser.

token.title: Admin sign-in
token.body: Enter the ADMIN_TOKEN configured on the gateway. It is kept in this tab's session only and sent as X-Admin-Token.
token.label: Admin token
token.disabled: The gateway has no ADMIN_TOKEN configured, so the admin API is disabled.
token.network: The gateway could not be reached.

overview.gpuNone: No worker running. One is launched on demand when a request needs a GPU and no API provider answers.

providers.title: Providers
providers.description: Each kind resolves to the lowest priority enabled row that passes the air-gap guard and whose last probe did not fail. LLM falls back to the on-demand GPU worker.
providers.empty: No providers configured yet. The env seed appears here after the first gateway start.
providers.deleteConfirm: Delete provider {{name}}? Model calls will fail over to the next enabled provider of this kind.
providers.secretsBanner: ACUDX_SECRET_KEY is not set on the gateway, so API keys cannot be saved. Providers without a key still work.

drawer.name: Name
drawer.nameHint: Shown in telemetry and the resolution log.
drawer.baseUrlHint: OpenAI-compatible endpoints include /v1. Under AIRGAPPED only loopback, private or allow-listed hosts resolve.
drawer.modelHint: Served model id. Leave empty for services that take no model.
drawer.apiKeyHint: Write-only. Sealed with ACUDX_SECRET_KEY on the server; the stored key is never shown.
drawer.apiKeyKeep: A key is stored (ends in {{last4}}). Leave empty to keep it, type to replace it.
drawer.priorityHint: Lower wins. Seeded local endpoints are 0, hosted fallbacks 10.
drawer.extraInvalid: Extra must be a JSON object.

gpu.title: On-demand GPU worker
gpu.description: Never always-on: a Lambda Cloud instance is launched when the LLM registry has no reachable API provider and terminated after the idle window or when the daily budget would be exceeded.
gpu.allowlistHint: One instance type per line; the cheapest with capacity wins.
gpu.regionsHint: Optional, one region per line, in order.
gpu.notConfigured: LAMBDA_KEY or LAMBDA_SSH_KEY_NAME is not set on the gateway.

telemetry.title: Model telemetry
telemetry.description: One row per gateway call. Cost comes from the versioned price table ({{version}}); self-hosted endpoints are billed by the hour in the GPU ledger instead.
telemetry.empty: No model calls in this window.

settings.title: Settings
settings.description: Operator settings persisted on the gateway. Budgets are advisory thresholds shown in the overview; the hard GPU cap lives in the GPU policy.
settings.llmBudgetHint: The overview turns amber when the 24 h model cost exceeds this.
settings.retentionHint: Rows older than this are candidates for purge.
settings.contactHint: Shown to learners on degraded-mode banners.
settings.rawHint: Advanced: edit any key. Must stay a JSON object.
settings.invalidJson: Settings must be a JSON object.
